title: Object Storage: standard primary unit rate
content:
Object Storage standard primary unit rate is defined as follows: Standard primary usage rate in USD per usage unit before region factors; decimal.

| Contract tier | Standard primary unit rate |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB | standard primary unit rate: 0.0218 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 10 TB | standard primary unit rate: 0.0214 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 25 TB | standard primary unit rate: 0.0208 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 50 TB | standard primary unit rate: 0.0202 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 100 TB | standard primary unit rate: 0.0196 |
| Northbridge Object Storage 250 TB | standard primary unit rate: 0.0189 |

## Tier reference

For Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB, the standard primary unit rate entry is 0.0218.
